text:
mia: prod alert — customers hitting 401 invalid_api_key on /v1/embeddings since the rotation at 10:02 UTC. billing console shows the key as active and not revoked. low blast radius but multiple apps. repro below.
mia: repro steps (from a failing machine):
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123xyz." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": "hello"}'
```
mia: response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error": {"type": "invalid_api_key", "message": "API key invalid"}, "request_id": "rx-7f3b2"}
ryan: thanks — can you paste the exact header value (obfuscate middle chars) and the request_id from the logs? also which deployment are the clients calling (hosted/dedicated/private)?
mia: header obfuscated: sk_live_A****3xyz. (note the trailing dot visible in the paste). request_id rx-7f3b2. clients are on hosted region us-west-2.
sam-support: quick thought: trailing punctuation from copy/paste often causes 401s (we've seen newline/space/zero-width, and now period). also check Authorization scheme — hosted should accept Bearer, but some customers use X-API-Key header and our proxy will reject mismatched key types for dedicated keys.
ryan: deploy-bot shows rotation job completed at 1714008500 for org: acct-998, new key sk_live_A...3xyz was issued and activated. no rollbacks. logs show 401s starting immediately after rotation.
sam-support: can you repro locally by explicitly removing the trailing dot in the header? try both forms.
mia: tried without dot:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123xyz" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": "hello"}'
```
mia: response now 200 OK. embeddings returned. :tada:
ryan: nice — so root cause is copy/paste added a trailing period when support engineer pasted the key into the ticket. recommend we add a small FAQ note and the quick CLI check in the support playbook: `key.endswith('.')` or use `echo -n` to verify no punctuation.
sam-support: filing a short KB: "Why am I getting 401 after rotation? Check for trailing punctuation and invisible characters" and include steps: `printf '%s' "$KEY" | hexdump -C` and `echo -n "$KEY" | wc -c` for length. pinging docs to add examples.
mia: closing loop with customer, they confirmed the extra dot came from copying from a sentence in the ticket. I'll update the incident and KB link when merged. thanks all :raised_hands:
